title: B Look and report
text: Su Hai makes a poster about recycling. Look at the poster and help her give a report. Try to use sentences with "what" and "how".
Every year, China recycles a lot of rubbish. It is really wonderful.
Our recycling centre is a very big place.
Here workers sort rubbish and recycle it. This is very important work.
We can make many new things with rubbish. It is really interesting.
Why don't you begin recycling today?
It is good for the Earth. It is good for us too.
Every year, China recycles a lot of rubbish. How wonderful! Look at the picture of this recycling centre. ...
How do you sort rubbish? Give some examples.
